ExecutiveSummary.OverallPosture: Passive external reconnaissance of kluniversity.in identified a medium exposure posture across 20 resolvable subdomain(s). The assessment surfaced 1 high-severity and 3 medium-severity indicators warranting structured remediation attention.
ExecutiveSummary.TopRiskOne: Sensitive service ports publicly reachable (21) — direct attack surface for credential brute-force, vulnerability exploitation, and lateral movement.
ExecutiveSummary.TopRiskTwo: HSTS header absent — browsers may permit unencrypted HTTP connections, exposing session tokens to network-level interception.
ExecutiveSummary.RecommendedNextStep: Prioritise remediation of High-severity findings within the next 30 days. Schedule a follow-up passive assessment in 90 days to track posture improvement.
ExecutiveSummary.PassiveAssessmentStatement: This assessment relied exclusively on passive, publicly observable signals. No intrusive testing, exploitation, or active probing was performed at any stage.
